from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib

from multidict import CIMultiDict
from aiohttp import web

assert r.headers is not h, 'Response aliased caller headers'
r.headers["X-New"] = "2"
assert "X-New" not in h, dict(h)
print('f2_headers_isolation', True)
